=== hello
        .text
        .globl  main
main:
        subq    $40, %rsp
        leaq    msg(%rip), %rcx
        call    puts
        xorl    %eax, %eax
        addq    $40, %rsp
        ret
        .section .rdata,"dr"
msg:    .asciz  "Hello from rsasm!"
=== data and bss
        .data
        .globl  counter
counter:
        .long   0
table:  .quad   f1, f2, counter
        .long   f1 - table
        .bss
buf:    .space  64
        .globl  big
big:    .zero   16
        .text
f1:     ret
f2:     ret
=== lcomm and comm
        .lcomm  local_buf, 32
        .lcomm  aligned, 8, 4
        .comm   shared, 24
        .comm   shared4, 8, 4
        .text
        movq    local_buf(%rip), %rax
        movq    shared(%rip), %rax
        leaq    aligned(%rip), %rcx
=== section flags
        .section .code,"xr"
        ret
        .section .rodat,"dr"
        .long   1
        .section .rw,"dw"
        .long   2
        .section .shared,"ds"
        .long   3
        .section .unread,"yd"
        .long   4
        .section .ubss,"b"
        .space  12
        .section .info,"i"
        .ascii  "note"
=== drectve
        .section .drectve,"yn"
        .ascii  " /DEFAULTLIB:msvcrt"
        .ascii  " -export:func"
=== long section and symbol names
        .section .averyverylongsectionname,"dr"
        .globl  a_very_long_symbol_name_indeed
a_very_long_symbol_name_indeed:
        .long   1
        .quad   another_long_undefined_symbol
=== dollar-grouped sections
        .section .text$mn,"xr"
        .globl  fn
fn:     ret
        .section .rdata$zzz,"dr"
        .long   fn
        .section .CRT$XCU,"dr"
        .quad   fn
=== alignment
        .data
        .byte   1
        .balign 8
        .quad   2
        .section .big,"dr"
        .p2align 12
        .long   3
=== absolute symbols
        .globl  abs_global
        abs_global = 0x1234
        local_abs = 42
        .set    later, 7
        .text
        movl    $abs_global, %eax
        movl    $local_abs, %ecx
=== set aliases
        .text
        .globl  target
target: ret
        .set    alias, target
        .globl  galias
        galias = target + 1
        call    alias
        .quad   galias
=== rva and secrel tables
        .text
        .globl  entry
entry:  ret
local:  ret
        .data
        .rva    entry, local, local+1
        .secrel32 entry
        .secrel32 local
        .secidx entry
        .secidx local
        .long   entry@IMGREL
=== cross-section references
        .text
        .globl  code
code:
        movq    thing(%rip), %rax
        leaq    stuff+4(%rip), %rdx
        call    code
        jmp     helper
helper: ret
        .data
thing:  .quad   code, helper, stuff
        .section .rdata,"dr"
stuff:  .long   thing - stuff
        .long   code - .
=== file symbol
        .file   "hello.c"
        .text
        .globl  f
f:      ret
=== long file name
        .file   "a/path/that/is/more/than/eighteen/bytes/long.c"
        .text
        ret
=== several relocations
        .text
        call    a
        call    b
        call    a
        movl    $0, c(%rip)
        leaq    d+100(%rip), %r8
        .quad   a, b, c, d
